calls.title: Publico + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting highlighted positive feedback from DM Tech regarding GrowthBook 4.4, emphasizing its strong market fit against competitors like Statsig, particularly after the OpenAI acquisition. The demonstration showcased an advanced visual editor featuring multi-language support, AI-driven editing, and traffic targeting capabilities designed for non-technical users. Discussions on enterprise pricing revealed a $50,000 annual entry cost for 10 user licenses, with interest from Jornal Público in more flexible pricing options. Additionally, Jornal Público expressed a need for tools that empower their non-technical teams to independently run experiments revolving around paywalls and pricing. The meeting concluded with plans for future follow-ups, including a detailed email outlining the enterprise plan scope and potential partnerships.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Visual Editor, Multi-armed Bandits, Feature Flags, Pricing Model, Piano Alternative
